To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have observed the spatially resolved formation of PAHs along a recently formed outflow from the PN NGC 7027 using SOFIA.
(1) PAH formation is likely occurring in the post-shocked region of the molecular envelope in NGC 7027 and (2) the PAH 6–7 μm emission feature is a reliable indicator of PAH formation.
we report evidence of polycyclic aromatic (PAH) formation in a recent outflow from a central star in the planetary nebula NGC 7027.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the spatial distribution of PAHs and warm dust in NGC 7027, and their formation and processing in a photo-dissociated region (PDR) surrounding the ionized nebula.
the formation of PAHs in the PN NGC 7027, where the PAHs are likely produced in the post-shocked environment of a recent outflow from the star.
the spatial distribution and abundance of dust grains and PAHs in the PN NGC 7027, and the role of grain–grain interactions in the formation of PAHs in dense post-shock regions.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the dust processing and rapid formation of PAHs in NGC 7027 is likely the result of the combined action of the photo-evaporated envelope, the central star’s radiation field, and a recent outflow from the star.
the PAHs in NGC 7027 are not formed in the ionized gas but rather in the post-shocked gas of the outflow. © 2016.

the dust processing and PAH formation in the outflow is a direct consequence of the interaction of the fast outflow with the dense envelope.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the spatial anti-correlaton of PAHs and dust optical depths in NGC 7027 is consistent with the hypothesis that PAHs are formed by the processing of dust in post-shock environments.
the 37 μm map can be used to identify regions where PAHs are being formed in PNs, and the 6.6 and 7.7 μm maps can be used to map the spatial distribution of PAHs.
the PAH formation rate is high enough in the post-shocked region that it can compete with PAH destruction.
